title: Qt: Remove dependency on Qt6 Core5Compat module
description:
Replace QTextCodec with GLib's g_convert_with_fallback() for character encoding conversion. Invalid bytes are substituted with U+FFFD to match previous behavior. Available encodings are probed at startup via g_iconv_open() from a static list.

Fix #21124 

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)

notes.body: We should probably just remove this file.

changed this file in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/25415/diffs?diff_id=1898452232&start_sha=3132f3dabada4210b8578fd0d46d9367a0a7b705#89926c786d4d86dc6293b4f9ad995893b7e7aeaa)
Would it make sense for this to be a `QMap<QString, const char *>`?
Yes it would, since the encoding names are static literals, no need for QByteArray copies

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/25415/diffs?diff_id=1898450705&start_sha=d7843d0a51d4feea13c38f1c37a9c187a08dfe24#1ba4327b93043544fe012ea43c19fc02c09f2b79_345_347)

We probably want to at least keep UTF-16 and UTF-32 (all endian), unless that's being provided through Qt's native support somewhere else. I also think that iconv, unlike Qt, doesn't tend to zero pad the codec names, so "IBM858" instead of "IBM00858", but that might depend on platform.

Fixed! and yes, correct about the zero

* IBM00858: FAIL (handle=18446744073709551615)
* IBM858: OK (handle=35536528)

When this is merged we'll probably need to download and run the *-setup.sh scripts from the release-4.6 branch when we build our various containers so that we continue to install the Core5Compat packages. We currently do this for the [Ubuntu container](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark-containers/-/blob/master/development/ubuntu/Dockerfile) but not the others.

I think we might want to backport !21866 / ~~eb20d6e3b361cc81141c0265f0b759277478f249.~~
I mean 37a5da9777e243eb348417e5ce76eb1593ab13e7.

Right now with the Rocky 9 container the rpm-setup.sh from master installs Qt6 but not Core5Compat, and the rpm-setup.sh from 4.6 installs Qt5, and then the CI builds try to build with Qt6 but fail to find Core5Compat.
